thread:
Evelyn (AE): AtlasRx has put our Dedicated quote on hold. They want: SOC 2 Type II cover page, ISO scope excerpt, a signed penetration-test attestation, and confirmation we can provide an isolated staging tenant for an authenticated 72h scan. Procurement needs this to release the PO.
Marcus (SE): We can stand up an isolated tenant. Need their scanner IP CIDRs and expected peak RPS. Important: they asked whether their auth scanner can exercise function-calling endpoints and the KV cache. That has extra risk -- we should gate which endpoints are allowed.
Rhea (InfoSec): We can provide a pen-test attestation template. Legal must sign off on the named signer. For KV/cache tests: we allow read-only probes; no destructive writes to caches or cache-priming that could persist. If they require authenticated fuzzing that touches secrets, that's a no without Private deployment.
Evelyn (AE): They specifically asked that the attestation reference remediation of critical/high issues in the past 12 months. Can we give a remediation ledger without exposing internal tickets?
Rhea (InfoSec): Yes  we provide a redacted remediation ledger: discovery date, severity, high-level mitigation summary, and internal ref. No raw tickets or payloads.
Marcus (SE): For authenticated scans we can issue a short-lived service principal (48-72h TTL). We'll rotate keys after the window and stream readonly audit logs to a bucket they can access. We also need to limit which APIs the principal can call (deny admin scopes).
Marcus (SE): Example presign for test assets (prefer synthetic data):
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-staging/atlasrx-test-data.tgz --expires-in 1800
# set bucket policy to only allow GET from their CIDRs
```
Victor (Legal): I'll review the attestation signer and draft a short SOW/NDA addendum that limits liability for the scan window and specifies allowed vectors (no kernel/driver fuzzing, no physical attacks). If they insist on officer-level signature, we'll need exec approval.
Evelyn (AE): Procurement timeline: they want artifacts and signed attestation by COB next Tue or PO is delayed another billing cycle. Pricing is on hold until we confirm staging access and the attestation.
Rhea (InfoSec): Also require that the tester provides an insurance certificate (cyber liability) and a named test plan. We'll refuse any tests that attempt to bypass rate limits or abuse prefix/KV caching to amplify load.
Marcus (SE): Cost note: if we carve out a dedicated staging pool and provide ops standby during the 72h scan, add a provisional +14% to Dedicated pricing. I'll firm up when they share expected qps.
ticket-bot: Ticket SLS-8124 created: "AtlasRx - pen-test attestation, SOC2/ISO excerpts, and staging scan coordination" assigned to Rhea (InfoSec). Priority: high.
Evelyn (AE): Action items: Rhea -> attach SOC2 + ISO excerpt and draft attestation; Victor -> SOW/NDA addendum and signer review; Marcus -> staging runbook, principal scoping, and preliminary cost delta. I'll ask AtlasRx for tester name, insurance cert, CIDRs, and an explicit allowed-API list.
Marcus (SE): One more flag: if they want to probe streaming/function-calling endpoints at high concurrency, we need a scheduled maintenance window to avoid impacting other customers. I'll note that in the runbook.
Evelyn (AE): Thanks all  I'll update the buyer and push for the tester docs. :thumbsup:
